To Cupid for reuenge of his vnkind and cruell Loue. Declaring his faithfull seruice and true hart both to the God of Loue and his Ladie
Hell tormenteth not the damned ghostes so sore as vnkindnesse the louer
The louer forsaketh his vnkinde loue
To those Honoured, Noble, and right Vertuous Friends, my Visitants in the Marshalsey: And to all other my vnknowne Fauourers, who either priuately, or publikely wished me well in my imprisonment.
